background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: All three of the main agencies rate the group, A on average and A- at the weakest of them, all three on a stable outlook, with no rating action since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 4 Nov 2022. Capital reads two ways against US banks: CET1 of 14.9% is in the top quarter while leverage of 4.9% is in the bottom quarter and has fallen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025, the one trend worth following. Liquidity is strong, LCR of 129% in the top quarter and broadly flat, as has CET1 been (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 28 Sep 2026, is share-price commentary, and the rest stem from a single misdirected email that exposed a deal pipeline, an operational and reputational matter with no bearing on the balance sheet.
